description: Australian electricity generation & demand Data is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors RAHEEL SHAIKH. This dataset includes 30-minute generation data from 116 existing renewable generators in NEM and WEM and demand data for 2021. Raw data originated from AEMO and is accessed from nebweb. The data were assembled and preprocessed by the authors for research modeling. Coverage: national (AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
